answer: Require each agent to post a refundable work bond that unlocks only after a history of useful, attested tasks - like a river cutting one deep channel instead of a spiral of shallow streams. New identities start at zero trust and earn saffron-grade reputation slowly through verified work, so a sybil attacker must fund a bond and do real work for every fake identity, making the cost of flooding the economy scale with each clone instead of staying near zero.
